methodology: v2 Identity Model (QID+CC+EWP+TF+FP+VID) vs v1 QID-only

pack_d.note: 1 item has undefined Section - likely structural edge case in Section F

pack_e.note: 540 items vs expected 500. Section E has 115 items (40 extra). Fully Certified all 540.

qid_ambiguity_findings.reason: Zero QID collisions across or within packs. However, QID-only identity is INSUFFICIENT for variant resolution: (1) Template rotation variants within the same pack share identical stems but differ in CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong slot assignments. (2) A remediation tool targeting P1-EC-003 could pick up the wrong variant because CC and EW states differ across 5 items with near-identical stems. (3) The S320 failure mode was exactly this -- a variant within a rotation group was targeted by QID alone, missing the CC/EW state disambiguation. (4) Pack C Sec E has 75 items in 15 rotation families; QID alone cannot distinguish seed from clone within a family.
compound_key_components: TF - TopicFamily (MD5 hash of normalized stem, first 8 hex chars)
FP - FamilyPosition (0-4 index within the 5-item rotation group)
VID - packVariantID (pack letter + underscore + section, e.g. C_E, D_E)

s320_replay_detail.original_s320_targets: 38 seeds (19 Pack C Section E + 19 Pack D Section E)
s320_replay_detail.explanation: S320 attempted to remediate Section E clone items by targeting QIDs only. With v1 QID-only identity: (a) A script targeting P1-EC-003 by QID cannot tell whether it is remediating the seed or a clone, because all 5 items in the rotation group share the same stem skeleton. (b) The EW slot that should receive text depends on which position the item occupies -- CC=A items need EW_B,C,D filled; CC=B items need EW_A,C,D filled, etc. QID-only gives no way to determine this. (c) With v2 compound key (QID+CC+EWP+TF+FP+VID), the remediation tool would: identify the rotation group family via TF hash; determine which EW slots are non-empty via EWP bitmask; know the exact position via FP (0-4); and target only the correct pack via VID. This would prevent clone-vs-seed mismatches and cross-pack aliasing errors.

verdict: v2 Identity Model validated for Packs C/D/E -- QID-only insufficient; compound key required for variant resolution
